Tom Holland’s Spider-Man: Brand New Day gets the Pitch Meeting treatment, and even as someone who loved the movie, it’s pretty funny watching some of its story choices get picked apart.

The video sarcastically digs into questions you may have had while watching the film. Are we really going to ignore all that awful stuff Jean Grey did? Why is Spider-Man so trusting? Why does Spider-Man: Brand New Day have so much less CGI?

There’s also the pressing matter of how this sequel completely ignores the events of Madame Web. Maybe the answers to all these mysteries can be found in the pitch meeting that got this movie made.

That’s what makes these Pitch Meeting videos so much fun. Loving a movie doesn’t mean you can’t laugh at the goofy logic, convenient decisions, and questionable character choices hiding inside it.

I had a great time with Spider-Man: Brand New Day, but that also makes it even more entertaining to watch the movie get roasted with some well-aimed jokes. The video has a good time pointing out the silly stuff without taking any of it too seriously, and if you enjoyed Tom Holland’s latest Spider-Man adventure, it’s a fun way to revisit the movie from a completely different angle.

Check out the Spider-Man: Brand New Day Pitch Meeting and enjoy the friendly abuse.
